notes: Our Lady of Lourdes, Harrisonville lists a Sunday 7:45 AM Mass 'at Holy Trinity', and Holy Trinity has the same number as Harrisonville in the diocese directory, so it is probably this church. But the page does not name Urich, and the diocese lists Urich as a mission of St. Patrick, Holden, whose site has no Urich times. Not entered until confirmed, the same way St. Lawrence (Greenup) was handled. No times are on the map for this parish. Mission of St. Patrick, Holden. Read from the parish's own website (https://ourladyoflourdesharrisonville.org/, https://www.stpatrickholden.org/mass-times) on 14 Nov 2026.
